# gunit — Full Reference

> Extended reference for contributors and advanced users. See [llms.txt](llms.txt) for the user-facing overview.

## Source Modules (`addons/gunit/src/`)

- `asserts/` — Fluent assertion implementations per type (Array, String, Signal, Vector, Dictionary, etc.)
- `core/` — Test case execution, discovery, events, attributes, versioning
- `core/execution/` — Test execution pipeline
- `core/discovery/` — Test discovery logic
- `core/event/` — Test event system
- `core/hooks/` — Test and session hook infrastructure (`GdUnitTestSessionHook`)
- `cmd/` — Command-line argument parsing (CmdArgumentParser, CmdCommandHandler)
- `doubler/` — Test double (mock/stub) code generation
- `mocking/` — Mock framework logic
- `spy/` — Spy/verification implementation
- `matchers/` — Argument matchers used in mock assertions
- `fuzzers/` — Fuzzy/parameterized test support
- `extractors/` — Value extraction utilities for assertions
- `monitor/` — Error and signal monitoring during test execution
- `network/` — Client/server for distributed test reporting
- `reporters/` — HTML and JUnit XML report generation
- `ui/` — Godot editor UI (Test Inspector panel)
- `update/` — Integrated update tool

## Test File Conventions

Tests mirror `src/` structure under `test/`. Example:
- `src/asserts/GdUnitArrayAssertImpl.gd` → `test/asserts/GdUnitArrayAssertImplTest.gd`

## Coding Conventions

**GDScript** — enforced by `gdstyle check` (gdstyle 0.4.0, configured by `gdstyle.toml`):
- Max line length: 180 characters
- Max file lines: 1000
- Max public methods: 40
- Max function arguments: 11

## GDScript Linting

```bash
gdstyle check --max-warnings 0 addons/gunit/
```

## Branch and PR Conventions

- Main branch: `main`
- Feature branches named after issue number (e.g. `GD-111`)
- PRs must link to an issue and pass all local checks
- Run `gdstyle check`, the GDScript test suite, and the Markdown lint locally before pushing
- Pushing a `v*` tag builds the addon release archive
- PR descriptions must include `# Why` and `# What` sections
